title: Prospective test of persistent same-budget source reuse

amendment.reason: The original null rule labeled the source effect transient or immaterial when either target family had G_U <= 1.02. That inference was too broad: a persistent gain on the other family would instead support geometry-family-conditional reuse.
amendment.correction: Apply the gates separately to each architecture-family cell, then distinguish broad persistence, broad null, family-conditional persistence, and unresolved intermediate effects.
amendment.information_boundary: This correction was made while the convergence extension was still running and without inspecting any continuation loss, validation metric, or test result.

information_boundary: Written while all 32 pretrained-64 versus scratch-128 continuation runs were still in progress. No convergence-extension loss, validation metric, or test result was inspected.
scientific_question: After equal target optimization, does DrivAerML initialization still improve prediction from the same 64 SHIFT-SUV training vehicles, even if it does not replace all 64 additional target vehicles in the scratch-128 arm?

rival_hypotheses.persistent_reuse: Pretrained-64 retains a material pressure-error advantage over scratch-64 after both have the same target-update budget and have plateaued.
rival_hypotheses.transient_warm_start: The pretrained-64 advantage disappears once scratch-64 receives the same target-update budget.
rival_hypotheses.family_conditional_reuse: The persistent advantage survives on one target body family but not the other.
rival_hypotheses.optimizer_censoring: The answer remains sensitive to the continuation learning-rate boundary or an unclosed learning curve and cannot yet be interpreted.

activation_gate.activate: Run this contrast if either architecture fails or is inconclusive at the registered half-label gate.
activation_gate.defer: If both architectures pass the half-label gate, first perform the registered multi-seed, multi-source-checkpoint confirmation.

contrast.target_cases: Use exactly the frozen nested 64-case target-training subsets from the parent adaptation pilot.
contrast.scratch_64_start: Use exactly the parent pilot's epoch-70 scratch-64 model weights, at 4480 target updates.
contrast.pretrained_64_reference: Use the already-registered pretrained-64 continuation results at the same three total target-update points.
contrast.optimizer_policy: Load model weights only; reset optimizer and scheduler exactly as in the ongoing convergence extension.
contrast.fixed_controls: Target seed, examples, batch size, sampling resolution, precision, loss, weight decay, augmentation policy, validation cases, and validation surface samples remain identical to the ongoing convergence extension.

analysis.primary: At each registered update point, select the scratch-64 continuation rate on the full 99-case validation set and compare against the already-selected pretrained-64 model using identical cases and point samples. Treat paired-case intervals as descriptive because selection uses the same validation cases.
analysis.selection_sensitivity: Repeat with the already-frozen deterministic five-fold case cross-fit: select the learning rate on four folds and evaluate it on the held-out fold. Cross-fit may block advancement but may not create it.
analysis.decision_scope: Apply every numerical gate separately to each architecture-family cell. Combine cells only through the explicitly named broad or family-conditional rules below.
analysis.test_policy: No SHIFT-SUV test case may be read or evaluated.

prospective_decision_rules.cell_material_gain: For one architecture-family cell at U=17920, G_U >= 1.05 in both the full-validation and cross-fit reductions; pretrained-64/scratch-64 wall-shear-stress error is <= 1.10; both curves pass the existing plateau gate; and no selected rate requires an untested outward flank.
prospective_decision_rules.cell_null_or_immaterial: For one architecture-family cell at U=17920, G_U <= 1.02 in both reductions after the plateau and learning-rate gates pass.
prospective_decision_rules.broad_persistent_gain: For one architecture, the cell-material-gain rule passes on both estate and fastback.
prospective_decision_rules.broad_null_or_immaterial: For one architecture, the cell-null-or-immaterial rule passes on both estate and fastback.
prospective_decision_rules.family_conditional_gain: For one architecture, the cell-material-gain rule passes on exactly one family and the cell-null-or-immaterial rule passes on the other. This supports family-conditional reuse and must not be reported as either broad persistence or a broad transient warm start.
prospective_decision_rules.inconclusive: Any stabilized cell between the two materiality gates, disagreement between full-validation and cross-fit ordering, or a failed plateau or learning-rate-boundary gate requires seed-variance estimation or additional convergence evidence rather than a directional claim.
prospective_decision_rules.architecture_claim_limit: A difference between architectures advances to seed replication; one target seed and one source checkpoint cannot establish an architectural transfer advantage.

next_question_if_gain_persists: For each architecture-family cell that passes the material-gain rule, what target-only sample count between 64 and 128 matches pretrained-64 error at the same update budget? Answer with frozen nested scratch counts before changing the source distribution or model architecture.
next_question_if_gain_does_not_persist: If every activated architecture-family cell passes the null-or-immaterial rule, can a different source distribution create reusable target information rather than merely a favorable initialization?
